instruction: Reply to Priya that Thursday works, and hold Thursday 10am for the call.
final_text:
I replied to Priya and booked the call for Thursday (Oct 1), 10:00–10:30am Pacific.

- **Reply:** I answered in her "Quick call this week?" thread. I said Thursday works, proposed 10:00–10:30am Pacific to go over the pilot scope, and told her an invite was coming. She asked for 30 minutes and said mornings are best for her, so that slot fits.
- **Calendar:** I created "Call with Priya Shah (Helio) – pilot scope" and invited Priya (priya@helio.example), so she has received the invite. You were free then: your standup ends at 9:45, and your next meeting is investor update prep at 2pm.

Best,
